basics.name: Mainak Mondal
basics.title: Autonomous Systems Engineer
basics.summary: I build and validate autonomous systems across robotics, edge compute, AI, and wireless networks - from physical test automation to connected-vehicle orchestration.

experience.role: PhD Engineering Intern - HAMR Component Testing
highlights: Developed and deployed automation tools for physical hardware testing workflows, reducing manual engineering effort by approximately 2,000 hours/year across a five-person team while enabling automated test tracking, failure detection, and faster experimental iteration.

Designed an end-to-end data pipeline to automatically retrieve, process, and upload experimental test data to a centralized visualization and analytics platform; developed interactive tools to identify trends and extract actionable insights, reducing manual data-processing overhead and accelerating engineering analysis.

Developed an agentic AI system using Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable natural-language querying, validation, and analysis of HAMR test data, improving traceability and accelerating insight generation.
experience.portfolioSummary: Automated HAMR hardware testing, saving approximately 2,000 engineering hours per year across a five-person team.

experience.organization: University of Connecticut — Cyber-Physical Systems Laboratory
highlights: Designed and deployed MIND-CAVs, a browser-based CARLA orchestration system for intent-driven autonomy in connected autonomous vehicles; combines LLM-assisted structured intent generation, V2X exchange, edge-agent negotiation, a FastAPI backend, React dashboard, WebRTC streaming, real-time telemetry, scenario control, and dataset capture for closed-loop autonomy experiments.
Built autonomous driving features on F1Tenth and QCar robots using ROS on Nvidia Jetson TX2, delivering lane keeping, obstacle avoidance, SLAM, and autonomous waypoint following.

Researched and deployed open-source 5G stacks (OpenAirInterface and SRSRAN) on ARM-based SBCs (Nvidia Jetson TX2) integrated with autonomous robotic platforms (F1Tenth, Quanser QCar); enabled low-latency V2V and V2I communication and supported field testing of 3GPP-compliant 5G NR features across PHY-PDCP layers.
Developed a reinforcement-learning charge-scheduling agent for mobile chargers in wireless powered communication networks, increasing sensor survival by ~20% while reducing travel distance by 5%.
Implemented autonomy on TurtleBot3 with ROS, including obstacle avoidance, SLAM, and waypoint following with a streamlined deployment pipeline.
experience.portfolioSummary: Research in connected autonomy, robotic platforms, and wireless powered sensor networks.

experience.organization: NR Tomsk State University — High Performance Reconfigurable Systems Lab
highlights: Built zero-trust long-range UAV control using ROS, MAVLink, Lightbridge, and ZeroTier for intercontinental operations.
Engineered infrared-guided multirotor UAV landing for GPS-denied environments, improving landing precision by ~40% on mobile pads.
Designed great-circle return-to-home control using PX4Flow for fail-safe navigation in GNSS-denied settings.
Developed medical/emergency delivery drones with automated payload handling during COVID-19.
Created an autonomous scout/attack UAV with radar-based threat detection and AlexNet-based interception, plus a ruggedized scout tank for hazardous environments.
experience.portfolioSummary: Developed UAV navigation, control, and landing systems for operation in GPS-denied environments.

highlights: Delivered APIs for the MEAN stack platform and optimized a hybrid Ionic app, cutting load times by 300%.
Partnered with clients to gather requirements, design mockups, and deliver tailored features end-to-end.
experience.portfolioSummary: Built web APIs and hybrid mobile applications, from client requirements through delivery.

highlights: Redesigned a plant complaint management system for the web, improving accessibility and enterprise integration.
Built the system with a C# backend and ASP.NET frontend following SOLID principles and integrated with inventory and general management tools.
experience.portfolioSummary: Developed a web-based plant complaint management system with enterprise integrations.

projects.challenge: Turn open-ended vehicle intents into typed, validated plans while preventing conflicting maneuvers at low latency.
projects.outcome: 95.4% safe completion, 0.8867 typed-output accuracy, and 31.95 ms local p95 arbitration across 32 simulated vehicles.
projects.title: MIND-CAVs Autonomous-Vehicle Orchestration
projects.impact: CARLA AI-in-the-loop dashboard with LLM intent, realtime telemetry, and dataset capture.
details: FastAPI backend orchestrates CARLA scenarios and WebSocket control flows.
Vehicles abstract observations into structured intents, exchange them over V2X, and receive globally consistent coordination plans from roadside edge agents.
React/Tailwind dashboard with telemetry overlays, control panels, LLM-assisted intent tooling, and dual MJPEG/WebRTC video paths.
Cloud logging records decisions for auditing and continual retraining, while frame capture exports telemetry and image datasets for experiments.

Evaluated multi-lane highway scenarios with conflicting maneuvers and route-constrained exits, improving maneuver completion time and reducing unsafe proximity and unnecessary braking versus isolated and baseline arbitration policies.

related.title: MIND-CAVs: Multi-Intelligence Negotiation and Decision System for CAVs based on Intent-Driven Autonomy

projects.challenge: Normalize telemetry from OAI and srsRAN into one operator-ready view without a local install.
projects.outcome: A live, serverless dashboard combines rolling radio metrics, UE status, and issue flags for rapid 5G RAN triage.
projects.title: 5G RAN Dashboard (srsRAN + OAI)
projects.impact: Zero-install 5G telemetry dashboard with a unified schema for srsRAN and OpenAirInterface.
details: Unified JSON schema ingests snapshots from srsRAN and OAI pipelines.
Realtime UE views and rolling charts for downlink/uplink metrics.
Simple inference layer flags drops, low CQI, and bitrate trends.
Serverless ingest API and persistent history for quick triage.

projects.title: Gym Reps Tracker
projects.impact: Vite + React tracker for workout plans, set counts, and weekly progress.
details: Configurable workout plan with day-by-day exercise lists and targets.
Local progress tracking for completed sets and weekly checklists.
Chart.js visualizations for quick progress review.
PWA-ready build setup for offline-friendly tracking.

projects.title: DJI IR + AprilTag Tracking
projects.impact: Monocular AprilTag tracking for DJI A3/N3 with assisted landing and follow modes.
details: ROS workspace scripts for camera streaming and AprilTag detection.
Assisted landing workflow driven by AprilTag pose estimation.
Follow-me mode to track and maintain relative position to tags.

projects.title: Tello Coordinate System Helper
projects.impact: ENU/NED coordinate helpers for DJI Tello flight commands.
details: Coordinate transform helper wraps easytello commands.
Delta-based move API for consistent coordinate control.
Lightweight utility for rapid Tello prototyping.

projects.challenge: Balance sensor urgency against robot travel cost while handling sparse rewards and uncertain energy consumption.
projects.outcome: Improved average sensor survival by about 20% and reduced travel distance by 5% across simulation and TurtleBot testing.
projects.title: RL-Based Mobile Sensor-Charging Robot
projects.impact: A reinforcement-learning scheduler and ROS navigation pipeline for sustaining wireless sensor networks.
details: Evaluated DQN, PPO, A2C, and independent-DQN policies against classic and optimization-based baselines.
Connected charging decisions to ROS navigation, SLAM, obstacle avoidance, and waypoint execution on TurtleBot3.
Validated the approach in Gazebo-based simulation and a physical TurtleBot testbed.

projects.challenge: Detect and track a landing target under changing lighting while maintaining stable control without GNSS.
projects.outcome: Physical flight tests improved landing precision by about 40% on mobile pads and produced related publications and patents.
projects.title: Infrared-Guided GPS-Denied UAV Landing
projects.impact: An infrared-beacon landing system for multirotor operation when GNSS is unavailable or unreliable.
details: Integrated infrared beacons, onboard sensing, flight-control logic, and ROS/MAVLink communication.
Implemented the landing approach and conducted physical testing on a multirotor platform.
The resulting work is documented through publications and two related FIPS patents.

projects.title: 5G-Enabled Robotic Communication Platform
projects.impact: Experimental V2V and V2I connectivity for autonomous robots using open-source 5G stacks and edge computers.
details: Integrated OAI and srsRAN with Jetson TX2, F1Tenth, and Quanser QCar platforms.
Instrumented 3GPP NR behavior across PHY through PDCP for network experimentation and data collection.
Current work focuses on resolving the OAI EDAF gNB build and documenting repeatable end-to-end latency tests.

projects.title: F1Tenth and QCar Autonomy Stack
projects.impact: ROS autonomy features deployed on edge-powered robotic vehicle platforms.
details: Implemented lane keeping, obstacle avoidance, SLAM, and autonomous waypoint following.
Deployed the stack on NVIDIA Jetson TX2 edge computers.
Integrated vehicle autonomy with experimental V2V and V2I communication workflows.

projects.title: GPS-Denied UAV Return-to-Home
projects.impact: Fail-safe multirotor homing using optical flow and onboard distance calculations when GNSS is unavailable.
details: Developed a non-GNSS homing algorithm using PX4Flow and Haversine-based distance calculations.
Integrated onboard state estimates with the flight-control workflow.
Evaluated localization drift, altitude-dependent optical flow, and environmental variation.

projects.title: Radar-Activated Scout and Interceptor UAV
projects.impact: A radar-triggered UAV with autonomous scan routines and onboard aerial-threat classification.
details: Connected low-altitude radar detection to UAV activation and autonomous scanning.
Used an AlexNet-based classifier for real-time aerial-object identification.
Integrated autonomous flight routines and a net-based interception mechanism.

projects.title: Autonomous Medical-Delivery Drone
projects.impact: A contact-minimized UAV workflow for transporting small medical and emergency supplies during COVID-19.
details: Integrated the vehicle, flight-control workflow, mission planning, and delivery payload.
Developed prototype software and assembled multirotor platforms for contactless distribution.
Conducted prototype testing while accounting for payload, endurance, communication, and safety constraints.

projects.title: Hazardous-Environment Reconnaissance Robot
projects.impact: A tracked robot for remote inspection of radiation- or gas-affected environments.
details: Integrated robot control, remote telemetry, and environmental sensor-data flow.
Designed for remote operation where direct human inspection would be unsafe.
Built as a master's project with sensor setup and calibration handled by other team members.

projects.title: Personal AI and Edge-Computing Homelab
projects.impact: Private infrastructure for self-hosted storage, media, remote services, local models, and agent experiments.
details: Runs Proxmox VMs and LXCs, OpenMediaVault, Jellyfin, Tailscale, Cloudflare Tunnels, and a dedicated Hermes agent VM.
Uses custom MCP integrations for infrastructure monitoring and routine administration.
Next milestones include centralized observability, tested backups, storage-health alerts, GPU passthrough, and disaster-recovery documentation.
